mechanism: Rasagiline is an irreversible MAO-B inhibitor that can potentiate sympathomimetic effects of lisdexamfetamine (which metabolizes to amphetamine), increasing risk of hypertensive crisis, serotonin syndrome, and cardiac complications.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if clinically necessary, use extreme caution with careful baseline and ongoing blood pressure monitoring, reduced amphetamine dosing, and patient education on dietary tyramine restriction.
